claims.statement: Management expects to grow the waterproofing and construction chemicals category at more than double digits.
claims.quote: Overall, we are looking at growing more than double digits in that category.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The economy segment remains the largest segment in the overall market for Asian Paints.
facts.quote: the economy segment will still be the largest segment in the terms of the market.

facts.statement: Interiors performed much better during the quarter due to extended monsoon affecting exterior painting.
facts.quote: The interiors would have done much better this quarter, given the fact that there was extended monsoon. And please remember, in the monsoon, the exterior painting suffers.
